correctness.rationale: An explicit faithful six-reflection action generates 51840 Weyl E6 elements. Exhaustive conjugacy closure gives 25 classes; the Smith product of each 7×m line-orbit sum matrix computes the index in its saturation. Independently, the Hermite-basis maximal-minor gcd gives identical indices for every class. The three exceptions are checked by direct geometric Picard basis calculations, and the order-9 H witness is verified as 3H for each orbit.

value.rationale: The cokernel is the natural integral descent obstruction for generating invariant Picard classes via sums of exceptional lines. Classifying exactly three exceptions among the 25 Weyl types is a structurally motivated full arithmetic classification; the order-9 example with 3H versus primitive H exhibits a genuine integer-lattice phenomenon invisible to rational line orbit data.
